title: Hall Speed and Position
text: Compute speed and estimate position of rotor by using Hall sensors, 6 inputs, 3 outputs, {Block output} sets Select output ports Speed and; {Counter size} sets the size of external counter register, {Counter clock frequency (Hz)} sets the clock frequency of external, {Discrete step size (s)} sets the sample time after which block executes again, {Number of pole pairs}, {Minimum detectable speed (RPM)} sets the minimum speed that block can detect, {Speed measurement interval} sets the interval over which block measures speed Every, {Speed unit} sets the unit of rotor angular speed output, {Speed datatype} sets the data type of rotor angular speed output, {Expected hall sequence in positive direction} sets the sequence indicating positive, {Sequence} sets the custom sequence indicating positive direction, {Order of extrapolation of position} Indicates precision in position computation 1st, {Position unit} sets the unit of angular position and {Position datatype} sets the data type of angular position output. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: HallVal
ports.summary: Current Hall sensor output state scalar

ports.name: SpdCnt
ports.summary: Count at Hall state change scalar

ports.name: Dir
ports.summary: Rotor spin direction during current Hall state scalar

ports.name: SpdVal
ports.summary: Validity of current and previous Hall states and speed calculation scalar

ports.name: HallChng
ports.summary: Value of Hall state change flag scalar

ports.name: HallChngRst
ports.summary: Resets Hall state change flag to zero scalar

params.name: Block output
params.values: Select output ports Speed and position (default) | Speed | Position

params.name: Counter size
params.values: Size of external counter register 32 bits (default) | 8 bits | 16 bits

params.name: Counter clock frequency (Hz)
params.values: Clock frequency of external counter 90e6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Discrete step size (s)
params.values: Sample time after which block executes again 50e-6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: Number of pole pairs available in motor 8 (default) | scalar

params.name: Minimum detectable speed (RPM)
params.values: Minimum speed that block can detect 20 (default) | scalar

params.name: Speed measurement interval
params.values: Interval over which block measures speed Every 180 Degrees (default) | Every 60 Degrees

params.name: Speed unit
params.values: Unit of rotor angular speed output Radians/sec (default) | Degrees/sec | RPM | Per unit

params.name: Speed datatype
params.values: Data type of rotor angular speed output single (default) | double | fixed point

params.name: Expected hall sequence in positive direction
params.values: Sequence indicating positive direction ABC (default) | CBA | Custom sequence

params.name: Sequence
params.values: Custom sequence indicating positive direction [5,4,6,2,3,1] (default) | scalar

params.name: Order of extrapolation of position
params.values: Indicates precision in position computation 1st Order (default) | 2nd Order

params.name: Position unit
params.values: Unit of angular position output Radians (default) | Degrees | Per unit

params.name: Position datatype
params.values: Data type of angular position output single (default) | double | fixed point
